items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: The night I brought Dizzy's bass player off?

ctx.x: I used to play a lot of rumbas when we were playing with different bands. I mean, with different fellas. But places we played, now they haven't been asking for rumbas. The last rumbas I played was a project. I played at Charity Hospital. Mm-hmm. Were you there that night?
The night I brought Dizzy's bass player off? Yeah, did we play any rumbas that night? I think so, maybe. I don't remember.
And didn't they have some young lady that asked for rumba and she got out there and was dancing?
